name: Fire Hardened Mail
summary: In Stormwind, Furen Longbeard offers an Alliance warrior a new design for Fire Hardened Mail. He will forge it if you bring rare materials from both continents.

sections.title: A Master Armorer's Ambition
sections.body: Furen Longbeard has forged an exceptional buckler for you. Now the dwarf armorer proposes a greater work: mail made to withstand fierce blows. His craft calls for more than iron or steel. He needs rare materials touched by elemental heat and natural resilience. Furen cannot leave his Stormwind forge, so you must gather these dangerous ingredients.

sections.title: A Cross-Continental Expedition
sections.body: Furen sends you to distant wilds and dangerous depths for the materials. The recipe calls for fangs from venomous spiders in the Wetlands' damp crevices. It also needs scorched and galvanized horns from fierce chimaeras in the Stonetalon Mountains. To bind and temper these beast parts into mail, Furen needs volatile phlogiston from Roogug, a geomancer deep within Razorfen Kraul's thorny maze in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a veteran dwarf armorer and shieldsmith in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. He crafts tailored defenses for promising warriors willing to help him.

faq.q: Why does Furen require such strange ingredients?
faq.answer: Furen needs unusual ingredients to temper metal beyond ordinary dwarven methods. His secret craft uses organic materials conditioned by natural venom, mountain winds, and breath weapons, together with volatile phlogiston.

faq.q: Where do the chimaera horns come from?
faq.answer: The scorched and galvanized horns come from chimaeras in Kalimdor's Stonetalon Mountains. The younger beasts and the formidable Chimaera Matriarch who leads them carry the horns.
Roogug, a quilboar geomancer, carries a vial of phlogiston in his lair at Razorfen Kraul, near the southern tip of the Barrens in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Which spiders carry scorched spider fangs?
faq.answer: Leech Stalkers and Cave Stalkers carry the scorched spider fangs. These giant arachnids lurk in the Wetlands' marshes and caverns in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: What happens after all the materials are gathered?
faq.answer: Once Furen receives the fangs, horns, and phlogiston, he begins forging a custom breastplate for you. He makes it in his forge as part of Furen's Armor.

angles.text: As a warrior, you prove your mettle by braving Kalimdor's wilds and deep dungeons to earn a piece of masterwork armor.
As a dwarf, you know true armor calls for unyielding materials taken straight from nature's harshest predators.
As an Alliance soldier, you venture deep into the Barrens and Stonetalon Mountains, where the Horde contests the land.
